description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the COD payment method extension in the OpenCart system. It includes methods for retrieving available payment options based on the customer's address and system configuration.

classes.name: COD
classes.description: A class extending the system model to implement Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available COD payment methods based on the provided address and current system configuration.
